- active pulse_tag
- result created_at, not the session's

   - Write samples.jsonl.gz.

- Report counts that match the prior scoping: 185 tags; about 28,834 eligible Pulses; tag-type distribution.

Commit with message "data(local-quant): Pulse tag catalog snapshot (185 tags, text-embedding-3-large)" and push the branch to origin. Do NOT include samples in git.
- Keep samples.jsonl.gz only on this machine. Do not upload it anywhere.

- file sizes
- the float32 verification
- the catalog branch name and commit sha

export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH
K=(kubectl --context prod -n duploservices-prod --request-timeout=120s)
Q=$(base64 | tr -d '\n')
case $1 in
  artemis) "${K[@]}" exec -i deploy/artemis -c artemis -- env Q=$Q H=duploartemis-prod-v2-replica.c8da0aw2akcu.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com python - < /tmp/wevo-ft-scope/runpy.py ;;
  pulse)   "${K[@]}" exec -i deploy/personas-api -c personas-api -- env Q=$Q RLS_BYPASS=1 /app/.venv/bin/python - < /tmp/wevo-ft-scope/runpy.py ;;

-- Exact cohort source join from customer-api src/data/pulseTags.js _getTagQuantData, aggregated per distinct pulse
with rows_ as (
  select pt.id as tag_id, pt.type as tag_type, ptt.pulse_id, aisr.id as result_id, aisr.created_at,
         (aisr.quant->'scores'->0->>'score') ~ '^-?[0-9.]+$' and (aisr.quant->'scores'->1->>'score') ~ '^-?[0-9.]+$'
           and (aisr.quant->'scores'->2->>'score') ~ '^-?[0-9.]+$' and (aisr.quant->>'average') ~ '^-?[0-9.]+$' as complete,
         (aisr.quant->'scores'->0->>'name') in ('Intuitive','Trusted','Valuable') and (aisr.quant->'scores'->1->>'name') in ('Intuitive','Trusted','Valuable')
           and (aisr.quant->'scores'->2->>'name') in ('Intuitive','Trusted','Valuable') as names_ok
  from wevo.pulse_to_tag ptt
  join wevo.pulse_tag pt on pt.id = ptt.tag_id
  join wevo.automated_insight_session_result aisr on aisr.automated_insight_session_id = ptt.pulse_id
  where ptt.deleted_at is null and aisr.quant <> '{}' and aisr.segment_id is null and pt.is_active is true),
per_pulse as (
  select pulse_id, max(created_at) as created_at, count(distinct result_id) as n_results,
         count(distinct tag_type) as n_types, bool_and(complete) as complete, bool_and(names_ok) as names_ok
  from rows_ group by pulse_id)
select to_char(date_trunc('month',created_at),'YYYY-MM') as month,
       count(*) as n_pulses, sum(n_results) as n_result_rows,
       count(*) filter (where n_types=3) as n_all3_types, count(*) filter (where n_types=2) as n_2_types, count(*) filter (where n_types=1) as n_1_type,
       count(*) filter (where complete) as n_complete_scores, count(*) filter (where not names_ok) as n_names_not_itv,

---C2
with rows_ as (
  select pt.id as tag_id, pt.type as tag_type, ptt.pulse_id, aisr.created_at,

           and (aisr.quant->'scores'->2->>'score') ~ '^-?[0-9.]+$' and (aisr.quant->>'average') ~ '^-?[0-9.]+$' as complete
  from wevo.pulse_to_tag ptt

  join wevo.automated_insight_session_result aisr on aisr.automated_insight_session_id = ptt.pulse_id
  where ptt.deleted_at is null and aisr.quant <> '{}' and aisr.segment_id is null and pt.is_active is true),
per_pulse as (
  select pulse_id,
         max(tag_id::text) filter (where tag_type='product') as p,
         max(tag_id::text) filter (where tag_type='industry') as i,
         max(tag_id::text) filter (where tag_type='asset') as a
  from rows_ group by pulse_id having bool_and(complete)),
combos as (
  select 'global' as kind, 'global' as key from per_pulse
  union all select 'product', p from per_pulse where p is not null
  union all select 'industry', i from per_pulse where i is not null
  union all select 'asset', a from per_pulse where a is not null
  union all select 'product_industry', p||'_'||i from per_pulse where p is not null and i is not null
